positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Ericsson Mobile Platforms  
• Cell Phone Radio Control Software:  
design and develop GSM/GPRS/EDGE physical layer software drivers to support Radio RF ASICs.  Software functionality includes driver development to control Radio RF ASIC, calibration of radio parameters and support of the industrialization process.  Utilizing In-Circuit Emulators, logic analyzers, and cellular protocol simulators to test and debug software.
Design and development of test program software to implement a Hardware Abstraction Layer for the Radio’s Network Signaling stack.

Ericsson IP Infrastructure / Redback Networks
• SNMP Team for development in Redback’s SmartEdge product line, an Edge Router that simultaneously serves as a broadband remote-access server (BRAS) to directly connect customers to the network.  
• Technical Lead Engineer, OAMP Team for the ISER, an Edge Router for Ericsson’s Blade System.  The ISER Network Element is managed via SNMPv2c.
  -  SoftwareMgr (upgrade and configuration), and AlarmMgr
  -  Site SNMP Technical Expert,  Identified the Standard SNMP MIBs used to manage the Network Element, updating these MIBs as the new standards/drafts came out.  Designed, wrote and maintained the Enterprise MIBs to extend and supplement these standards.

positions.title: Member of Scientific Staff
positions.description:
•  Technical Lead Engineer, SNMP Team for the MG9K, a VoiceOverPacket Access Gateway (VoIP, Switched Lines over ATM).    Network Element/Gateway is managed via SNMPv2c / v3.  Network Element (NE) Agent was developed with SNMP Research’s Emanate Stack.  
Software developed using objected oriented design and C++.   
 
•  MG9K Gateway OAMP:  
•  Developed SNMP MIB access code for all MIBs, notification implementation, and MIB implementation for such common MIBs as the Interface-MIB, Entity-MIB, Target, Notification-MIB, etc.
•  Designed and developed NE Alarm and Notification System.  Includes the Central Active Alarm List, the AlarmLog, the application-to-SNMP Notification generation system, and implementation of the AlarmMIB.
•  Designed and developed the Management Information Base DataView/Model.  This included the MIB index-to-application directory, and the service objects which either store or transport the OAMP (SNMP MIB-based) items between the applications.

positions.title: Senior Sofware Engineer
positions.description:
• Development of a telecomm system to offload Internet dial and hold traffic from existing voice networks.  
 - Gateway OAMP - Designed and developed the Alarm/Fault System, in C++.  
 - Developed the Event Distributor to distribute alarms to the web-based GUI {IExplorer, with Java applets to enable the browser to function as the GUI for the element Manager}. 

• Developed an SNMP Agent for CallCenter Switch.  Designed the Enterprise SNMP MIB for this Agent, based on concepts for AlarmManagement specified in the X.721, X.733 and Q.821 specifications

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and implemented ISYSCON, the U.S. Army’s Tactical Communications Network Management System, object oriented software in C++, using CMIP (and SNMP Proxy Agent).

•  Designed and developed software system in both UNIX/XWindows and PC/MS Windows in C++ to provide interactive, terrain/map based graphics display and manipulation, communications propagation analysis and performance prediction (TIREM), and data processing for MSE network planning and management.

•  Developed detailed Discrete Event simulation models and tools to accuractly depict full switch communications network, including terrain analysis, graphic network configuration, dynamic Mobile Subscribers, availability and failures, EW and security impacts, expansions to evaluate Echelons Above Corps, Theater-wide communications and MSE Packet Switch Networks.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: •  Developed Discrete Event simulations to analyze and evaluate LAN’s and configurations for NASA’s major Mission Control Center Ground Support Systems.  Developed Telemetry Processing Computer Interface Model simulations to evaluate and predict performance of software modifications to telemetry downlinks system.
